name: BOM2Lib
description: Build a project-local KiCad library (symbols, footprints, 3D models) from an EasyEDA BOM
description_full:
BOM2Lib turns an EasyEDA BOM export (CSV) into a complete, project-local KiCad library.

It prompts for a project name, extracts all LCSC part numbers from the BOM, downloads CAD data from the public EasyEDA API and writes:
  - <project>.kicad_sym  (symbols, each pre-linked to its footprint)
  - <project>.pretty/    (footprints, also referenced via ${KIPRJMOD})
  - <project>.3dshapes/  (WRL + STEP 3D models)
  - sym-lib-table / fp-lib-table  (auto-registered for the project)
  - an optional empty .kicad_pro/.kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb skeleton

If kicad-cli is available, all files are upgraded/validated into native KiCad format automatically. Re-running with the same BOM is fast: already imported parts are cached and skipped unless Overwrite is checked.

Runs as an Action Plugin: Tools > External Plugins > BOM2Lib (in Pcbnew or Eeschema).

EasyEDA library data remains (c) JLCEDA/EasyEDA and must be attributed when shared. Conversion uses a vendored copy of easyeda2kicad.py (MIT).
